question: Which of the following was the theme of Independence Day 2023?

options.text: Support our Troops, Salute our Troops

solution:
The Correct answer is __**Nation First, Always First**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The theme **Nation First, Always First** symbolizes the prioritization of the **nation's interests, unity, and sovereignty.**
 
• This theme emphasizes the importance of placing the **country above personal, regional, or political interests.**
 
• It reflects a sense of patriotism and a commitment to the progress and welfare of **India.**
 
• The slogan aligns with India's vision of becoming a global leader and reinforces the citizens' role in supporting **national unity and development.**
 
• It was highlighted during the **Independence Day celebrations in 2023**, marking India's journey of 76 years since gaining freedom.
 
• The theme resonates deeply in the context of **India's democratic ideals, inclusive growth, and cultural heritage.**
 
• It also underscores the importance of collective responsibility and dedication toward building a strong and self-reliant nation.
 
• This theme connects with the broader vision of **Aatmanirbhar Bharat (Self-Reliant India)** and sustainable development goals.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Towards True Freedom**__

 __
 
• This phrase typically represents the journey toward achieving **complete freedom**, including social, economic, and political liberation.
 
• It symbolizes the elimination of inequalities and barriers that hinder **individual and collective progress.**
 
 
 
• **Support our Troops, Salute our Troops**__
 __
 
• This phrase is dedicated to honoring the contributions of the **armed forces** in safeguarding the sovereignty and security of the nation.
 
• It highlights the role of **soldiers** in maintaining peace and defending the country's borders.
 
 
 
• **One Country, One People**__
 
 
• This slogan emphasizes the importance of **unity and national integration.**
 
• It seeks to eliminate divisions based on **language, religion, or regional identities** and fosters a sense of collective identity.
